subject: math

fields.name: 数与代数
fields.description: Covers quantities, operations, expressions, equations, and functions.

fields.name: 图形与几何
fields.description: Focuses on shapes, spatial reasoning, measurement, and geometric transformations.

fields.name: 统计与概率
fields.description: Deals with data collection, analysis, chance, and inferential reasoning.

fields.name: 综合与实践
fields.description: Emphasizes logic, proof, problem solving, modeling, and discrete structures.

areas.name: 整数与运算
areas.description: Students learn place value, addition and subtraction within 100.

areas.name: 乘除法基础
areas.description: Students master multiplication tables and division with remainder.

areas.name: 分数与小数
areas.description: Students understand fraction equivalence, operations, and decimal notation.

areas.name: 比例与比例推理
areas.description: Students work with ratios, proportions, and percent problems.

areas.name: 一次式与一次方程
areas.description: Students simplify algebraic expressions and solve linear equations.

areas.name: 二次式与二次方程
areas.description: Students factor quadratics, solve by completing square and formula, and graph parabolas.

areas.name: 函数与图像
areas.description: Students interpret functions, domain/range, and graph linear, quadratic, and exponential functions.

areas.name: 数列与级数
areas.description: Students study arithmetic and geometric sequences, sums, and sigma notation.

areas.name: 多项式与高等代数
areas.description: Students perform polynomial operations, factor theorem, and are introduced to complex numbers.

areas.name: 图形与空间想象
areas.description: Students identify and describe 2D and 3D shapes and their properties.

areas.name: 长度、面积、体积测量
areas.description: Students measure perimeter, area of rectangles, and volume of prisms using standard units.

areas.name: 角与初等几何
areas.description: Students classify angles, explore triangle properties, and are introduced to the Pythagorean theorem.

areas.name: 解析几何基础
areas.description: Students plot points in the Cartesian plane, compute distance and midpoint.

areas.name: 变换与对称
areas.description: Students investigate translations, rotations, reflections, and similarity transformations.

areas.name: 圆与三角函数基础
areas.description: Students explore circle theorems, trigonometric ratios, and solve right‑triangle problems.

areas.name: 立体几何与体积表面积
areas.description: Students compute surface area and volume of prisms, cylinders, pyramids, and spheres.

areas.name: 向量与解析几何
areas.description: Students perform vector operations, dot product, and study lines and planes in space.

areas.name: 微分几何导论
areas.description: Students encounter basic concepts of curvature and curves in preparation for advanced geometry.

areas.name: 数据收集与表示
areas.description: Students gather data and display it using tally marks, pictographs, and bar graphs.

areas.name: 集中趋势度量
areas.description: Students calculate mean, median, and mode and interpret their meaning.

areas.name: 概率基础
areas.description: Students conduct simple experiments and compute probabilities of equally likely outcomes.

areas.name: 数据分布与变异
areas.description: Students explore range, quartiles, box plots, and an introduction to standard deviation.

areas.name: 概率分布
areas.description: Students study binomial and normal distributions and use them to model random phenomena.

areas.name: 统计推断
areas.description: Students learn sampling methods, confidence intervals, and introductory hypothesis testing.

areas.name: 回归与相关
areas.description: Students fit linear models, compute correlation coefficients, and assess goodness‑of‑fit.

areas.name: 多元统计
areas.description: Students extend to multiple regression and are introduced to principal component analysis.

areas.name: 概率论基础
areas.description: Students study axiomatic probability, expectation, variance, and law of large numbers.

areas.name: 逻辑推理与证明
areas.description: Students learn basic logic, set notation, and proof techniques such as direct and contradiction.

areas.name: 解题策略
areas.description: Students apply Polya’s heuristics and various strategies to non‑routine problems.

areas.name: 数学建模
areas.description: Students translate real‑world situations into mathematical models and interpret results.

areas.name: 离散数学基础
areas.description: Students study sets, relations, functions, and introductory graph theory.

areas.name: 数论导论
areas.description: Students explore divisibility, prime numbers, modular arithmetic, and Diophantine equations.

areas.name: 微积分基础
areas.description: Students grasp limits, derivatives, and basic integration and their geometric meanings.

areas.name: 抽象代数
areas.description: Students study groups, rings, fields, and their homomorphisms.

areas.name: 实分析
areas.description: Students rigorously examine limits, continuity, differentiation, and integration.

areas.name: 微分几何
areas.description: Students explore curves, surfaces, curvature, and the basics of manifolds.

areas.name: 拓扑学
areas.description: Students learn about open sets, continuity, compactness, and connectedness in topological spaces.

areas.name: 复分析
areas.description: Students study analytic functions, contour integration, and residue theorem.

areas.name: 数值分析
areas.description: Students develop algorithms for solving equations, interpolation, and numerical integration.

areas.name: 千以内数的认识
areas.description: Students learn to read, write, and compare three-digit numbers using place value concepts.

areas.name: 加减法策略
areas.description: Students develop fluency with mental and written strategies for adding and subtracting within 1000.

areas.name: 乘法概念初步
areas.description: Students explore multiplication as repeated addition and begin to use basic multiplication facts.

areas.name: 长度与时间测量
areas.description: Students measure objects using standard units of length and tell time to the nearest five minutes.

areas.name: 多位数乘除法
areas.description: Students multiply and divide up to 4-digit numbers by 1-digit numbers using standard algorithms.

areas.name: 分数运算理解
areas.description: Students add and subtract fractions with like denominators and multiply fractions by whole numbers.

areas.name: 条形图数据解读
areas.description: Students read, create, and interpret bar graphs to solve problems and draw conclusions.

areas.name: 计数符号与图画图数据收集与表示
areas.description: Students gather simple data and display it using tally marks and picture graphs to answer questions.

areas.name: 因数、倍数与质数
areas.description: Students identify factors and multiples of numbers, and recognize prime and composite numbers up to 100.

areas.name: 复合图形周长与面积
areas.description: Students calculate perimeter and area of shapes made by combining rectangles and squares.

areas.name: 折线图表示数据
areas.description: Students organize measurement data in line plots and interpret trends such as mode and range.

frontierHints: University abstract algebra courses study groups, rings, and fields as foundational structures.
Real analysis provides the rigorous underpinnings of calculus and measure theory.
Differential geometry investigates curved spaces, essential for general relativity and modern physics.
Topology explores properties preserved under continuous deformations, influencing many mathematical fields.
Complex analysis extends calculus to complex numbers, with applications in engineering and physics.
Numerical analysis focuses on algorithms for approximating solutions to mathematical problems.
